lines.text: 到了七千转，一切都会隐去。机器变得没了重量，简直消失。只剩一具身体穿过空间与时间。七千转——你在那儿遇见它。它问你唯一要紧的问题：你是谁？
lines.en: There's a point at 7,000 RPM where everything fades. The machine becomes weightless. Just disappears. And all that's left is a body moving through space and time. 7,000 RPM. That's where you meet it. ... Asks you a question. The only question that matters. Who are you?
lines.character: 卡罗尔·谢尔比 / Carroll Shelby
